From my heart

Happy Birthday, Anushka ❤️🎂

Happy Birthday, Anushka ❤️🎂 When we first met, we were just friends, and honestly, I never imagined that I would meet someone who would change my life in such a beautiful way. But since you came into my life, I’m not the same person anymore. You’ve made me more mature, more responsible, and made me look at my life, my family, and my future differently. Somehow, my priorities changed, and you became one of the most important parts of my life. ❤️ You truly are my lady luck, and I’ll always be grateful for the person you’ve helped me become.
